text:
maya: Quick sync  I'm consolidating 429, timeout, and context-limit troubleshooting into one canonical error-ref page. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410

samir: Good idea. Can we add tiny SDK drop-in snippets (Node + Python) that show graceful fallback and the recommended header to avoid double-retries? Keep them one-call examples.

lisa: Also add a migration note for teams using the old client-side retry wrapper; they saw duplicate retries after enabling the unified handler. Recommend either disabling the wrapper or setting X-RI-Retry-Mode=disabled on wrapper calls. One sentence.

samir: Node snippet (minimal):
```js
// fallback to cheaper model on 429
const r = await client.generate({ prompt });
if (r.status === 429) {
  await client.generate({ prompt, model: 'gpt-lite', headers: { 'X-RI-Retry-Mode': 'graceful' } });
}
```

samir: Python snippet (minimal):
```py
# fallback to cheaper model on 429
r = client.generate(prompt)
if r.status_code == 429:
    client.generate(prompt, model='gpt-lite', headers={'X-RI-Retry-Mode':'graceful'})
```

jordan: Add a tiny policy example to explain latency/quality tradeoffs (one json blob).

jordan: policy example: { "preferred": "gpt-4-std", "fallback_order": ["gpt-4-small","gpt-3.5-lite"], "max_latency_ms": 450 }

lisa: For context limits: show a before/after prompt-trim example and recommend trimming recent non-essential user turns first, then system anchors. Mention console helper: `context-trim --preserve=system --max-tokens=2048`. One-line example.

alex: Edge-case: streaming + 429 mid-stream. Recommend aborting and treating partial as incomplete; for resumable streams include `X-RI-Resume-Offset` with last token index.

doc-bot: lint: docs/error-ref.md has 3 broken links and 1 style warning. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/4789/logs

samir: I'll take the Node snippets and fix links that still point to the old retries page. Will push later today.

lisa: I'll author migration blurb + context-trim before/after examples. ETA tomorrow AM.

jordan: I'll add the small policy example and a one-line observability note suggesting headers: X-RI-Route, X-RI-Trace, X-RI-Retry-Mode for ops correlation.

maya: Who can run a post-merge link sweep across docs and SDK pages? There are internal cross-links that need redirects.

jordan: I can scan product and SDK pages and file redirects for ambiguous cases.

maya: Plan: fix CI broken links, land PR Friday EOD. Add troubleshooting bullet for streaming partials + 429 (alex's note) and a one-line observability snippet showing `X-RI-Route=dedicated` so support can correlate fallbacks.

alex: Also suggest trace header example: `X-RI-Trace=team-id:request-id` for easier trace queries.

maya: Added to checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
